name: WTI Crude Oil: Price Action & Volatility
description: Daily analysis of WTI crude oil (CL futures) showing price action, rolling annualized volatility (20d and 60d), and key summary statistics including 1-year high/low, current volatility, and 1-year return.
source:
# =============================================================================
# WTI CRUDE OIL: PRICE ACTION & VOLATILITY
# =============================================================================
# Charts:
#   1. xy_lines: WTI daily close price
#   2. xy_lines: Rolling 20-day and 60-day annualized volatility
#   3. summary_table: Current price, 1Y high/low, 20d/60d vol, 1Y return
#
# Dataset:
#   - CL-Futures with BackwardPanamaCanal continuation adjustment
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

bar_ts = index()

# --- Volatility (annualized: daily vol * sqrt(252)) ---
vol_20d = basic_volatility(period=20, type=BasicVolatilityType.return_type)(close) * sqrt(252)
vol_60d = basic_volatility(period=60, type=BasicVolatilityType.return_type)(close) * sqrt(252)

# --- Summary Stats ---
high_252 = max(period=252)(close)
low_252 = min(period=252)(close)
ret_1y = returns(period=252)(close)

# --- Chart 1: WTI Daily Close Price ---
xy_lines(
    title='WTI Crude Oil — Daily Close',
    category='1. Price Action',
    y_axis_label='Price (USD/bbl)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    order=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='WTI Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(bar_ts, close)

# --- Chart 2: Rolling Annualized Volatility ---
xy_lines(
    title='WTI Rolling Annualized Volatility',
    category='2. Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Vol',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day Vol', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Day Vol', color=Color.Sky)
    ])
)(bar_ts, vol_20d, vol_60d)

# --- Summary Table ---
summary_table(
    category='3. Key Statistics',
    order=2,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='WTI Crude Oil Summary',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Price', 'Volatility & Return'],
        col_headers=['Current / 20d Vol', '1Y High / 60d Vol', '1Y Low / 1Y Return'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Price', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='1-Year High', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='1-Year Low', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='20d Vol', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='60d Vol', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='1Y Return', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    )
)(close, high_252, low_252, vol_20d, vol_60d, ret_1y)
